name: Sugito (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sugito town emblem in green: a stylised dove with a raised wing.
history: Municipal flag of Sugito, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1990.

features.role: Sugito town emblem — a stylised dove with a raised wing
